reference.comparator: whole-serving efficiency is paired against the reference tree as served with the sheared-bias kernel off on pip FA4 and every other SGLANG_OPT_USE_INKLING_* fused path off; launch_env applies to the reference server only

launch.source: the registered class's popen_launch_server command, captured at T0 health

deadlines.rule: each node's wall is larger than the operations inside it, which keep their public limits (eval/inkling_small/limits.json); the launch and teardown walls are the startup and teardown limits plus 60 s

sizing.measured: the longest reference draw of each axis in the verifier's own reference phase on a 4xB200 host: decode_c1 draws 19.28 / 18.54 / 18.62 s, throughput 17.68 s (one draw then)

l3_excluded.registered.attention.test_flash_attentio: environment_unavailable: it launches a server for Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, a second checkpoint the image does not carry, fetched at run time; with the network blocked it errors on every tree. The file holds no other member id, so it is not run.
l3_excluded.registered.attention.unittests.dense.tes: incompatible with the verifier's restore: this case's base test helper python/sglang/test/kits/attention_unittest/runner_modes/cuda_graph_decode_runner.py is restored to the base, where it does not pass the keyword argument a solved FA4 backend needs, so it raises AttributeError on every tree.
